cd "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
SRC='terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_minus01_centered_1448x1448_rotated_cw0p5_clean_upper_right_724x724.png'

 if test -f "$p"; then printf 'ADDITIONAL_APPLICABLE_DOCUMENT %s\n' "$p"; cat "$p"; echo 'HALTING_FOR_DOCUMENT_REVIEW';exit 18;fi
done

python3 -m venv /tmp/fishfry_mesh_21_23_1px_venv

/tmp/fishfry_mesh_21_23_1px_venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from hashlib import sha256
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageChops, ImageFont
src=Path('terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_minus01_centered_1448x1448_rotated_cw0p5_clean_upper_right_724x724.png')
directory=Path('terminal/tasks/fishFry/mesh_vertical_line_sweep_21_to_23')
directory.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
with Image.open(src) as im:
    base=im.convert('RGB')
assert base.size==(724,724),base.size
results=[]
for spacing in (21,22,23):
    out=base.copy()
    d=ImageDraw.Draw(out)
    locations=list(range(0,724,spacing))
    for x in locations:
        d.line((x,0,x,723),fill=(0,0,0),width=1)
    assert all(b-a==spacing for a,b in zip(locations,locations[1:]))
    allowed=Image.new('L',(724,724),255)
    mask_d=ImageDraw.Draw(allowed)
    for x in locations: mask_d.line((x,0,x,723),fill=0,width=1)
    changed=ImageChops.difference(out,base).convert('L')
    assert ImageChops.multiply(changed,allowed).getbbox() is None,'Unexpected pixel changed'
    for x in locations:
        assert out.getpixel((x,0))==(0,0,0)
        assert out.getpixel((x,723))==(0,0,0)
    dest=directory/f'vertical_spacing_{spacing}px_width_1px.png'
    out.save(dest,format='PNG',compress_level=6)
    with Image.open(dest) as check:
        assert check.size==(724,724)
        assert ImageChops.difference(check.convert('RGB'),out).getbbox() is None
    print('IMAGE',dest,'SPACING',spacing,'WIDTH',1,'LINES',len(locations),'SHA256',sha256(dest.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),flush=True)
    results.append((spacing,dest))
assert len(results)==3
sheet=Image.new('RGB',(3*340,380),(250,250,250))
draw=ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
try:
    font=ImageFont.truetype('DejaVuSans.ttf',22)
except OSError: font=ImageFont.load_default()
for i,(spacing,dest) in enumerate(results):
    x=i*340
    draw.rectangle((x+4,4,x+335,375),fill=(255,255,255))
    draw.text((x+12,12),f'{spacing} px spacing, 1 px lines',font=font,fill=(0,0,0))
    with Image.open(dest) as im:
        thumb=im.convert('RGB').resize((316,316),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
    sheet.paste(thumb,(x+12,50))
sheet_path=directory/'comparison_spacing_21_22_23px_width_1px.png'
sheet.save(sheet_path,format='PNG',compress_level=6)
with Image.open(sheet_path) as check: assert check.size==(1020,380)
assert len(list(directory.glob('*.png')))==4
assert sha256(src.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='4e6728722184fa091512afdf733ce2e72e822cc17369aeda49a936d923f22c74'
print('COMPARISON',sheet_path,'SHA256',sha256(sheet_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),flush=True)
print('VERIFIED','all three full-resolution images, each from untouched source; 1-pixel-wide black lines; 21/22/23 spacing; plus contact sheet',flush=True)
PY
git add -- "$DIR"
test "$(git diff --cached --name-only | wc -l)" -eq 4
git -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' commit -m 'Add 21–23 px spacing variations with 1 px mesh lines'
gh auth setup-git
for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8;do
  printf 'PUSH_ATTEMPT %s\n' "$attempt"
  git fetch --quiet origin main
  git -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' rebase origin/main
  if git push origin HEAD:main;then
    printf 'COMMITTED ';git rev-parse HEAD
    printf 'REMOTE_HEAD ';gh api repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/git/ref/heads/main --jq .object.sha
    for f in "$DIR"/*.png;do
      LOCAL_SHA=$(git hash-object "$f")
      REMOTE_SHA=$(gh api "repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/contents/$f" --jq .sha)
      test "$LOCAL_SHA" = "$REMOTE_SHA"
      printf 'VERIFIED_REMOTE %s %s\n' "$f" "$REMOTE_SHA"
    done
    printf 'VERIFIED_REMOTE_COUNT ';find "$DIR" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.png' | wc -l
    exit 0
  fi
done
echo 'PUBLICATION_FAILED' >&2
exit 1
